source: opencode.ai/console (logged-in workspace, dark theme): Activity, Settings, Models
method: getComputedStyle on live elements; colors normalized to sRGB hex (@n% = alpha)

typography.note: Two weights only (440 regular, 530 emphasis). Negative tracking on 13-15px, positive on 11px.

material.summary: Every raised object is lit from above: a dark drop, a 0.5px white rim, and a 0.5px brighter top edge (negative y offset). Fills are translucent white over the panel, so the same component works on every layer.
material.switch_track: inset 0 -0.5px 0 #fff@10%, inset 0 0 0 0.5px #fff@16%; fill gets linear-gradient(transparent, #fff@10-20%) bottom sheen
material.hairlines: 0.5px everywhere; table rows use 1px #fff@8%; tab underline is a 1px white bar inset 11px from the tab edges; header rule is a 0.25px #fff@20% ::after

radius.sm: 4px (menu items, switch track, first table cell)

layout.frame: Top bar (44px, 8px padding) on the deep #080808 window; the app is one panel inset 8px left/right/bottom with 10/14px corners and the raised-panel shadow.
layout.tab_bar: 49px, padding 0 24px 0 13px, items 28px tall with 0 11px padding and 2px gap, sliding 1px underline
layout.content: 64px top padding, 32px side margins, 960px centered column (Activity) or 244px sticky aside + 640px column (Settings)
layout.settings_nav: 180px items, 28px tall, padding 0 6px, gap 8px, 16px icons, search field 28px on top with 16px below
layout.settings_group: title above the card (16px gap); card padding 20px; rows separated by 0.5px #fff@10% lines with 20px bottom padding; label 13/530 over description 13/440 muted, control right-aligned, 24px gap
layout.card_header: padding 16px, title row + muted description with 4px gap
layout.card_footer: padding 16px, actions left, 1x12px #fff@20% vertical divider, muted hint
layout.table: header 32px 13/500 faint, rows 48px, cells padding 0 12px, 1px #fff@8% row lines
layout.steps: 20px numbered bubble + 1px #fff@20% connector line, 24px gap to content, 16px between title block and actions

components.button: 32px (page) / 28px (nav, header), padding 0 15px (0 11-12px small), radius 6px, 13/530, bg #fff@6% + small_control shadow
components.split_button: one 32px raised shell, radius 6px, two halves separated by a 1px #fff@20% line
components.nav_item: 28px, padding 0 11px, radius 6px, text #808080 idle → #fafafa active, hover bg #fff@6%
components.tab: 48px hit area, 28px label pill, idle #808080, active #fafafa, underline slides
components.input: 28px, radius 6px, recessed #161616 with 2% top gradient, small_control shadow, padding 0 8px
components.switch: 24x16 track, radius 4px, padding 2px; 12x12 knob radius 2px (squared, not round); on = #3b5cf6
components.menu: bg #242424, padding 2px, radius 6px, menu_popover shadow; items 27px, padding 0 12px, radius 4px, 13/440
components.step_bubble: 20x20, radius full, bg #fff@6%, small_control shadow, 11/530 muted

motion.switch: 90ms ease-out for knob transform and track background

ux_patterns: Monochrome UI; color only for state (Connected in green, accent blue for on switches and links).
Translucent white fills instead of fixed greys, so controls adapt to whichever layer they sit on.
Square-ish geometry: 2/4/6px radii, squared switch knob; only bubbles and avatars are round.
Settings as label + description on the left, control on the right, one card per group.
Hairlines at 0.5px and a lit top edge give depth without heavy shadows.
